subject: Proposed evaluation & procurement sequencing for HealthGrid pilot
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Teresa Morales <t.morales@healthgrid.io>, Procurement Team <procure@healthgrid.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jan 2026 15:14:00 +0000
Subject: Proposed evaluation & procurement sequencing for HealthGrid pilot

Hi Teresa / HealthGrid procurement,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. I promised to put a concise mutual action plan (MAP) and timeline in one place so your legal and procurement teams can see exactly how the MSA / DPA / order form fit into the evaluation window.

Attached: HealthGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx (simple milestone rows) and an Evaluation_Checklist_HealthGrid.pdf. High-level proposal below:

- Week 0 (this week): Finalize MAP; your legal to confirm any must-have contract terms flagged in the sheet.
- Week 1: Access for eval engineers (sandbox keys, sample dataset subset).
- Week 2: Two-day performance/latency run and security questionnaire check.
- Week 3: Legal review & initial MSA redline; procurement issues (billing entity, PO cadence).
- Week 4: Sign MSA + DPA or agree to redline capture; order form with committed pilot units.

Ask: Can you confirm the procurement contact who will own PO cadence and whether your legal needs pre-existing customer docs (e.g., ssa, vendor questionnaire) returned by Feb 12?

If helpful, Ben can join a short call to go through the MAP and commercial points. Suggested time slots attached in the sheet.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0122
From: Teresa Morales <t.morales@healthgrid.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@healthgrid.io>, Joshua Klein <j.klein@healthgrid.io>
Date: Fri, 30 Jan 2026 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation & procurement sequencing for HealthGrid pilot

Camila, thanks for the clear MAP. A few items from our side:

- Legal will want to push a couple of data residency clarifications into the DPA (we host some patient-adjacent telemetry in us-west only).
- Procurement needs to confirm the billing entity (we have two: HealthGrid, Inc. and HealthGrid Labs). Who should the PO go to?
- Can you provide the sandbox key TTL and whether logs from the pilot are retained beyond 30 days by default?

I've uploaded an initial MSA redline that our counsel suggested; attaching as MSA_Redline_HealthGrid.pdf. We'll ask redwood legal for a narrow review — turnaround target of 5 business days if possible.

Teresa Morales
Head of Procurement & Legal Ops, HealthGrid
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Teresa Morales <t.morales@healthgrid.io>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 14:01:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation & procurement sequencing for HealthGrid pilot

Teresa — looping in a couple quick commercial clarifications so procurement has context:

- Billing: For pilots we typically invoice the legal entity named on the order form. Camila, please confirm which HealthGrid entity you want on the order form; we can accommodate both but need to align on tax info.
- Discount: I have pre-approved a pilot credit of up to $12k in committed usage credits (will show on the order form as a line item). Formal approval is contingent on PO or signed order form.

If legal's target for a 5-business-day turnaround on the MSA redline is tight for you, we can offer a 30-minute legal-to-legal sync to accelerate. Karthik — are you available Tuesday AM?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Teresa Morales <t.morales@healthgrid.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation & procurement sequencing for HealthGrid pilot

Teresa — thanks for the redline. A few operational items from my side (legal and infra):

- Sandbox key TTL: default 72 hours; we can extend to 2 weeks for specific test accounts if you provide the list of test engineers.
- Logs retention: pilot logs are kept 30 days by default; for evaluation we can create a temporary extended-retention bucket for 90 days if needed (we'll need a signed DPA or a temporary addendum).

Lauren — can you prepare a short onboarding checklist so HealthGrid's engineers can get keys and sample data access next week?

Karthik Iyer
Director, Cloud Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Teresa Morales <t.morales@healthgrid.io>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 12:43:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation & procurement sequencing for HealthGrid pilot

Hi Teresa — I've attached a one-page onboarding checklist in the shared Drive link and will run the sandbox setup Tuesday afternoon.

Quick next steps from my side:
- I will send sandbox keys to j.klein@healthgrid.io (TTL 2 weeks) once we get the list of test engineers.
- I'll schedule a 45-minute kick-off to walk through the evaluation checklist and share sample notebooks.

Attachment stub: Evaluation_Checklist_HealthGrid.pdf (drive link included in MAP)

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Technical Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Teresa Morales <t.morales@healthgrid.io>, Procurement Team <procure@healthgrid.io>

Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 20:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation & procurement sequencing for HealthGrid pilot

Thanks everyone — summary and ask (so procurement/legal have a single checklist):

1) HealthGrid to confirm billing entity for PO by Feb 9 (HealthGrid, Inc. or HealthGrid Labs).
2) HealthGrid legal to confirm whether the redline in MSA_Redline_HealthGrid.pdf is the final set of asks; if so, we will target a legal-to-legal sync on Feb 5 to resolve open items.
3) HealthGrid to send list of test engineers (emails) for sandbox keys by Feb 4 so Lauren can provision 2-week TTL keys.
4) Redwood will provide an initial invoice/credit memo line showing the $12k pilot credit once PO or signed order form is confirmed.

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with these action items and due dates and share a Drive link in the morning.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
